name: Yellow-billed Blue Magpie
extract: The yellow-billed blue-magpie or gold-billed magpie (Urocissa flavirostris) is a passerine bird in the family Corvidae, along with crows and jays. It forms a superspecies with the Taiwan blue magpie and the red-billed blue magpie. The species' range covers the northern parts of the Indian subcontinent, including the lower Himalayan foothills, with a disjunct population in Vietnam.
